content.title: Ohio To Gain Hundreds Of Jobs As Centrus Energy Ramps Up Nuclear Production
content.summary: Centrus Energy Corp. (NYSE: LEU) announced Thursday it will expand its uranium enrichment plant in Piketon, Ohio, in a project that could generate more than 1,000 construction jobs and 300 new operations jobs. The facility will produce both low-enriched uranium (LEU) and high-assay, low-enriched uranium (HALEU), which are critical fuels for current and next-generation reactors.
